_comment_en: Project Bro ROOT-open enforcement, AUTHORED BY SUPERBRO and DELIVERED to <project>\.claude by bro-install (governed; wall-to-root). This is the daily-driver entry: opening the project ROOT activates the 5-hook wall. The bro/\.claude variant (no prefix) still covers opening bro/ directly. The guards compute home from their own location (X/bro), so behavior is identical at either open-point.
